picks.summary:
Is It A Sin to Write in Your Bible? : Bible Study 101



Before the color method starts, there's a hurdle a lot of us have to get over first. Rachael is about to ask you to take a highlighter to your Bible, and for some of you that feels close to sin. This episode deals with that honestly, walks through what Deuteronomy 6 actually tells God's people to do with His words, and explains why physically marking a page changes what your brain is able to take in. There's also a practical setup list for the week ahead, and none of it requires spending money.

picks.title: Was Paul an Eyewitness of Jesus' Resurrection?
picks.summary: In a recent response to Wes Huff, Bart said the only eyewitness we know of who's converting people is Paul. A lot of people pointed out that Paul never met Jesus. Fair. But Paul is also the only person in the New Testament who tells us, in his own words, that he saw Jesus alive after his death. Everyone else reaches us secondhand. Bart unpacks what Paul actually claims to have seen, why Paul is the only person who claims to see a resurrected Jesus, and why the earliest firsthand evidence for the resurrection suggests visions.
picks.reason: Bart Ehrman discusses Paul's claim of seeing the risen Jesus with historical insight.
